# Spec: Send an email through a channel

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/send-an-email.md)

**Start:** `/messaging/communications`  
**Persona:** A developer wiring notifications into an application  
**Goal:** Send a message through the public channel and read the acknowledgement.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Choose a channel and write the message | The Public channel is selected by default. |
| 2 | Send | The result says the mail was accepted. |
